id: title:Gilbert09:point to destinations when no source matches

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a destination setup link and contextual help message in the warehouse source selection UI, supporting warehouse-to-warehouse or warehouse-to-destination workflows.
review.reason: The change adds a dependency on shared URL helpers and updates the warehouse source selection UI to display a 'Set up a destination' link when no sources match, alongside existing options. This is a localized, bounded UI improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of this UX change and its adoption are not demonstrated by the code; this is a potential benefit, not an observed outcome.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are supplied; no other hunks. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for shared URL helpers.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the component to construct destination URLs without a local dependency, supporting the UX change in P1.F1.H2.

observations.behavior: Rearranges JSX and adds a new message and link when no sources match, while preserving the existing 'Clear filters' and 'Request one' options.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a contextual help message and a link to destinations for users who land on the source catalog after an export, potentially reducing confusion and supporting the warehouse-to-warehouse or warehouse-to-destination workflow.
